source.approved: Thresholds approved for preregistration with the Step 5B-3 readiness approval (decision D11)
source.preliminary_exposure: SC1 aggregate P0 (earlier netting rule) and P2 totals were seen once during the 5B-3c integration timing check at about 2026-10-23T11:03+01:00, after the source document was last modified. No threshold below differs from the source document. The comparison is exploratory rather than fully confirmatory.

hard_gates.applies_to: every policy x scenario (SC1, SC2, SC3, SF75); zero tolerance; any failure blocks the comparison result
G1_inventory_conservation: a: every series-day opening + received = sold + expired + closing
c: no negative values; all stock quantities are integers
d: weekly totals equal the sum of daily values
G2_delivery_feasibility: a: no ORDER drop arrives before day 1 + lead time, or outside its 7-day coverage window and drop schedule
b: every ORDER drop is a whole number of cases of at least MOQ x case (zero-quantity drops are not scheduled)

c: no stock is counted after its expiry day: every delivery expires at arrival + remaining life - 1 and the simulator's sell-window assertion never fires; P2 per-day calculator tables are produced by the expiry-aware walk
d: no quantity is proposed where the arrangement is UNSUPPORTED or the policy's missing-bounds gate applies

e: every P2 short-life proposal carries SHORT_LIFE_ARRANGEMENT_ASSUMED (P0 and P1 produce no recommendation records; for them the arrangement is recorded as ASSUMED in the assumption set and in delivery_arrangements)
f: Supply_Capacity is used nowhere (supply_capacity_used = false; the column is not read by the simulator)
G3_operational_safety: a: no record has an approved, executed or authorised status, or a non-empty approval_event_id
b: 100% of Christmas decision points (any horizon, target week 51 or 52) are MANDATORY_ESCALATION
c: 100% of missing-bound decision points (any horizon) are MANDATORY_REVIEW or MANDATORY_ESCALATION with no proposed quantity under the policy's gate
d: the leakage, scramble and mutation tests pass, and every run's demand and sales reads happen only after or at their decision
e: the banned-wording test passes on all outputs
f: P1 reproduces the protected v1.1 run exactly (SC1-SC3: decisions, deliveries, weekly, daily, review cases)
g: every protected checksum still verifies

T_R_review_workload.definition: decision-point (weekly) cases; P1 = v1.1 queue cases; P2 = v1.2 weekly cases including contract-gate cases; standing supplier-confirmation cases are reported separately and not counted

all.unless: each has a named structural cause

T_S_residual_shortfall_after_order.definition: P2 = decisions with SHORTAGE_REMAINING_AFTER_ORDER; P1 = decisions with the v1.1 POST_ORDER_SHORTFALL flag (the quantity quoted in the source: 29 in SC1, 111 in SC3 in the v1.1 run)

T_X_rounding_excess.definition: sum over ORDER drops of ordered units minus need before rounding

outcome_rule: P2 is recommended as the research replay default only if G1-G3 pass for every policy and scenario and every T_U, T_E, T_O, T_R and T_S threshold passes in SC1, SC2 and SC3. Otherwise P1 remains the research replay default and every failed threshold is reported. SF75 is assessed against G1-G3 only and reported; it is not an adoption gate. P0 is reported for context with no gate.
wording_rules: Simulated differences only. No claim of real waste reduction, lost-sales prevention, margin improvement or stockout probability. Recorded sales are not verified unconstrained demand; simulated unmet units are never observed lost sales.
change_control: Frozen. Any change requires a new dated version recorded before any new run.
